{{Quote|Ortolan. I'd know them if they were six days old and covered in jam. Those are Ortolan tracks.|[[Talos Drellik]], to [[Darth Nox]]|<ref name="SWTOR>{{TORcite|type=general|Scouring the Wastes|Hoth}}</ref>}}
'''Jam''' was a condiment enjoyed with [[Bread/Legends|bread]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. It was stored in jars.
